test1A.description: 200 synchronous resize events from inside one evaluate; coalescing should limit real passes
test1A.notes: Coalescing working: 0 real resize passes for 200 events

test1B.description: Viewport changed to 900x1000, then 50 synchronous resize events fired
test1B.notes: Coalescing OK: 2 passes for 50 events at 900x1000

test1C.description: DPR override 0.75/1/1.25/1.5/2 with 1280x800 CSS viewport; check CSS box = viewport, buffer = viewport*dpr, ratio ≈ 1.0
test1C.notes: All DPR settings: CSS box matches viewport, buffer matches viewport*dpr, ratio ≈ 1.0 — no stretch bug

test1D.description: After 1280→900→1280 resize cycle, sample glyph canvas twice ~700ms apart; zero differing pixels = frozen renderer
test1D.notes: Render loop stays alive after resize cycle

test2.description: Knot centring via largest 4-connected component on downscaled glyph grid; ~12 samples at 500ms intervals; cx must be in [0.48, 0.52]
test2.notes: Centring bug detected at one or more viewports
